name: 服务合同管理 (426)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item covers the management of service contracts in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Service. Service contracts are outline agreements that define services offered for a particular period and represent long-term service agreements with customers. Service contracts are billed on periodic billing plan. Via price adaptations for service contract, different prices within the contract periods are possible. Optionally, customers can choose ad-hoc billing, a structured method of service contract billing that allows you to define billing values and billing dates manually.

Customer-specific price agreements can be defined and handled within service contracts. Service contract determination is enabled for service orders that correspond with the service contract in predefined criteria – in this case, contract and price details from determined service contract are considered.

Customers can define service level agreements and maintain service/response profiles in service contracts.

It’s possible to renew an expiring service contract automatically for a predefined period at a predefined date. If needed, you can also manually renew service contracts and items. As part of the change process, you can change the sold-to party of a service contract and a new service contract is automatically created.

Furthermore, you can create and configure a configurable service contract item. To use this option, scope item " Set up configurable model using variant configuration" is needed as a prerequisite.

This scope item includes situation handling for service contracts. Situation handling is SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition functionality that lets you bring certain circumstances (situations) to the attention of a relevant group of business users.

Key Process Flow

  • Create Service Contract and Add Service Contract Items with Periodic and/or Ad-Hoc Billing Plan
  • Maintain Product List and Create Price Agreements for Service Product
  • (Optional) Create Service Contract Item with Configurable Product
  • Adapt Service Contract Prices
  • Release Service Contract and Service Contract Items
  • Schedule and Manage Billing Document Requests
  • Create Billing Request Lines (Only valid for Ad-hoc Billing)
  • Create Invoice
  • The following service contract change processes are possible:
    • Change Sold-to-Party in Service Contract (Optional)
    • Manually Renew Entire Service Contract (Optional)
    • Manually Renew Service Contract Item (Optional)
    • Auto Renewal of Service Contract Item (Optional)
    • Cancel Service Contract or Service Contract item (Optional)

Business Benefits

  • Flexible and powerful service contracts that reflect your customers' needs
  • Enable flexible pricing with price adaptation or manual prices
  • Use full integration into SAP S/4 billing
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目涵盖 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 服务中的服务合同管理。服务合同是框架协议，用于定义在特定期间内提供的服务，代表与客户的长期服务协议。服务合同根据定期开票计划进行开票。通过服务合同的价格调整，可以在合同期间内使用不同的价格。或者，客户可以选择即席开票，这是一种结构化的服务合同开票方法，允许您手动定义开票值和开票日期。

可以在服务合同中定义和处理客户特定的价格协议。为与预定义条件中的服务合同对应的服务订单启用服务合同确定 - 在这种情况下，将考虑确定的服务合同中的合同和价格详细信息。

客户可以定义服务级别协议并维护服务合同中的服务/响应参数文件。

可以在预定义日期自动续订预定义期间的即将过期的服务合同。如果需要，您还可以手动续订服务合同和项目。作为更改流程的一部分，您可以更改服务合同的售达方，并自动创建新的服务合同。

此外，您可以创建和配置可配置服务合同项目。要使用此选项，前提条件是需要范围项目“使用变式配置设置可配置模型”。

此范围项目包括服务合同的情况处理。情况处理是 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 功能，允许您提请相关业务用户组注意特定情况（情况）。

关键流程流

  • 创建服务合同并添加含定期和/或即席开票计划的服务合同项目
  • 维护产品清单 和 创建服务产品的价格协议
  • （可选）创建含可配置产品的服务合同项目
  • 调整服务合同价格
  • 发布服务合同和服务合同项目
  • 计划和管理开票凭证请求
  • 创建开票请求行（仅对即席开票有效）
  • 创建发票
  • 允许以下服务合同更改流程：
    • 更改服务合同中的售达方（可选）
    • 手动续订整个服务合同（可选）
    • 手动续订服务合同项目（可选）
    • 自动续签服务合同项目（可选）
    • 取消服务合同或服务合同项目（可选）

业务优势

  • 提供灵活、强大的服务合同，反映客户的需求
  • 通过价格调整或手动价格实现灵活定价
  • 使用与 SAP S/4 Billing 的完全集成
